explanation: It is 0 at every GO and D2 step and only lights up at D1 when the previous trial was rewarded and the agent had chosen a1. It hits about 10 when that reward came right after an unrewarded trial (most often an a1 choice that rarely reached S2 and still paid), then fades over each further rewarded a1 trial (about 7, 4, 1, then 0), and stays 0 after unrewarded trials, after a2 choices and during long reward streaks.
